about: compiler/driver: workspace manifests, Go/Ergo replacement resolution, DoD SoA package discovery, CSR import wave scheduling, cycle detection, and cache keys (SELFHOST-DRIVER-CLI).

mutants.name: driver-cli-modfile-missing-module
mutants.rule: An ergo.mod without a module directive must fail ParseModFile with ParseError.

mutants.name: driver-cli-gomod-wildcard-beats-exact
mutants.rule: An exact-version go.mod replace overrides a wildcard replace for the same module path.

mutants.name: driver-cli-workfile-cycle-unrejected
mutants.rule: Cyclic ergo.work task dependencies must be rejected with ParseError.

mutants.name: driver-cli-workfile-skip-prefix-overbroad
mutants.rule: A workspace skip directory matches only exact folder or slash-bounded descendants.

mutants.name: driver-cli-discover-admit-testdata
mutants.rule: Recursive discovery never enters testdata directories.

mutants.name: driver-cli-discover-nested-module-walked
mutants.rule: Recursive module target traversal stops at nested module boundaries.

mutants.name: driver-cli-graph-wave-collapsed
mutants.rule: Every importing package sits in a strictly higher topological wave than all of its dependencies.

mutants.name: driver-cli-graph-cycle-undetected
mutants.rule: Import cycles are rejected with a CycleError holding the dependency chain.

mutants.name: driver-cli-graph-replace-ignored
mutants.rule: Cross-module imports resolve local go.mod replace directories into CSR dependency edges.

mutants.name: driver-cli-cache-ignores-file-digest
mutants.rule: PackageActionKey incorporates every source file content digest.
